summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Real-time Fall Alert UI (Global Alert Banner + Live Page Active Alerts Section). All 13 requested features are working correctly. The Global Alert Banner displays on Dashboard and Live pages, shows alert count with 'non acquittees' badge, has all required action buttons (Acquitter, Resoudre, Faux, eye, X), sound/collapse toggles. Live Page's Active Alerts Section shows detailed alert cards with fall location coordinates (X, Y, Z), elapsed timers, status timeline (Detectee → Confirmee), TEST badges for simulated events, and action buttons. All button actions (Acquitter, Resoudre) work correctly - alerts are acknowledged/dismissed as expected.
